AUTHOR: Myrvold
TITLE: Monitoring Fish Assemblages in Seasonal Off-Channel Habitats Using Underwater Video and Computer Vision
REGION: Gudbrandsdalslågen River backwater slough, Lake Mjøsa delta, Norway
SPECIES: perch, pike, bream, roach, ide, Eurasian minnow, nine-spine stickleback, common dace, tadpoles (Bufo/Rana)
DATA: Own continuous underwater video at culvert entrance, 2020 (training, 85,194 frames) and 2021 (test, 113 x 30-s clips)
V_EV: Sec. 2.7: 'We scored the clips by the following categories: footage colour (day/night); murkiness (clear/moderate/murky); algal growth on the camera lens (yes/no); and backlight'
D2: Train/val on 2020 footage; test on 113 clips from 2021
D_EV: Sec. 2.2: 'The computer vision model was developed based on the 2020 material and tested on the 2021 material.'
R_EV: Sec. 4.2: 'trained and validated on footage from 2020 and then tested on material from 2021 in the same location'; val mAP 0.95 vs test ICC by cutoff
C_EV: Sec. 2.7: counts recorded 'at prediction probability level cutoffs ranging from 20% to 90% in 5% increments'; species-specific optima (e.g. roach 60%, pike 80%)
E_EV: Sec. 2.7: 'We thus compared manually derived species counts to the results of the software'; ICC of 0.90 for roach at 60% cutoff
ARCH: YOLOv5 detector + SORT tracker, majority-vote species label per track
METR: mAP@0.5 (validation), confusion matrix, MOTA/MOTP, ICC vs manual counts, ANOVA of count error vs conditions
NOTE: Test on following year (2021) at same site counted as external (season/year rule). R3=Y because in-domain validation mAP and external test agreement are both numeric, though metrics differ (mAP vs ICC) - verifier may judge R3=N. Murkiness scored qualitatively (clear/moderate/murky) and tested via ANOVA against count error -> V6=P, V7=Y. Counts objects not individuals (re-entries counted twice) - no duplicate handling -> C5=없음. Tracking MOTA 0.94 on a limited murky clip.
